descriptionMarkdown:
Some weapons and class features can Suppress a 
target. When a creature is required to make a 
Suppression save, use the attacker's weapon save DC: 8 
+ proficiency bonus + the ability modifier used for the 
attack. A creature that fails is Suppressed until the start 
of the source's next turn unless a rule gives a different 
duration.
● Disadvantage on ranged weapon attacks.
● Cannot willingly move closer to the source of 
Suppression.
● Cannot take reactions.
A creature behind Full Cover from the source 
automatically ends Suppression if the source can no 
longer threaten its position, at the GM's discretion.
